description.en: Original nominal18m representative floodplain land/bed patch: a current through-river is separate from a horseshoe-shaped abandoned depressed channel. Both old-channel ends close into sediment/land necks, with real basin/bank relief and no water or lights exported. Generic cutoff/infill teaching concept, not a bent estuary, elongated plunge pool, measured river event/site/age, complete watershed or hydrodynamic simulation; landscape scale and original river facet preserved.
description.zh: 原创名义18米泛滥平原土地床面裁片：贯通现主河与马蹄废槽相互分离，旧槽两端由沉积陆颈封闭，凹地岸坡真实几何，无水体灯光导出。通用截弯填淤教学概念，非河口改弯/深潭拉长，不作实测河流事件地点年代/完整流域/水动力模拟，保留landscape尺度与原river生境。
